Alex Cho: Heads-up: I need to land PR #20495 (users schema + migration) before Sat 2024-06-15 11:00 UTC maintenance window. CI macOS matrix is flaky — failing uuid-derive test. Can we get a rebase slot + quick review? cc @Jen Park @Ben Miller
Jen Park: On it. I can take a look after stand. Which job is failing?
Alex Cho: macos-unit (macos-12). Error snippet:
```
FAIL tests/test_uuid.py::TestUUID::test_derive_uuid
AssertionError: expected 16 != 0
Command: pytest -k test_derive_uuid -q
```
Priya Rao: I can re-run the mac matrix. I'll queue it now: /rerun macos-matrix
CI Bot: CI rerun requested for PR #20495, job macos-unit queued (job id 1298)
SRE-Bot: Maintenance window Sat 11:00-12:00 UTC. Recommend landing by 10:30 UTC to allow rollback if needed.
Ben Miller: I'll be around at 09:45 UTC. If tests green and diff small I'll approve — ping me with the link.
Alex Cho: pushed a small change to fix flaky assertion (avoid relying on monotonic UUID ordering). force-pushed sha abc123 -> def456
Jen Park: quick read: code looks fine, but can we add a tiny unit assertion fix? I'll push suggestion.
Jen Park: pushed suggestion as commit def789, no API surface change.
CI Bot: macos-unit passed (job 1298). all checks green for PR #20495
Ben Miller: LGTM :thumbsup: approving now
Ben Miller: approved PR #20495
Alex Cho: planning to merge at 10:15 UTC. If anything blocks, call it out now.
SRE-Bot: noted. I'll hold the rollback hook ready.
CI Bot: merge queue accepted PR #20495, merging on green.
Alex Cho: merged and deployed to staging at 1729506822
Jen Park: thanks team — nice quick turnaround :tada:
Priya Rao: verified migration run on staging, no errors
Ben Miller: great. I'll keep an eye during the maintenance window.
